summary: CBRE Group, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into an underwriting agreement for the issuance and sale of $750 million aggregate principal amount of 5.250% Senior Notes due 2036. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration statement. Proceeds are intended to repay commercial paper borrowings. The filing is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation characteristics such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring are present.
